personal_info.summary: Versatile Full Stack Developer with over 5 years of experience delivering scalable, user-focused web applications using modern JavaScript frameworks and backend technologies. Skilled in developing secure RESTful and GraphQL APIs, architecting relational databases, and building responsive UIs with component-driven design. Adept at managing end-to-end project lifecycles—from database modeling to frontend integration—using tools like React, Next.js, TypeScript, Laravel, Node.js, and PostgreSQL. Proven track record implementing real-time data dashboards, interactive user workflows, and internal productivity tools that streamline operations and enhance usability. Strong collaborator who bridges technical and non-technical teams, adapts quickly to shifting requirements, and consistently ships clean, maintainable code. Passionate about continuous improvement, performance optimization, and delivering business value through thoughtful engineering.

responsibilities: Developed and maintained secure RESTful APIs using Laravel and PostgreSQL, enabling core platform features including subscriptions and scheduling.
Built responsive front-end interfaces with React and Next.js, improving user engagement and performance across devices.
Integrated third-party services such as Jitsi (video calls) and Google Maps to enhance real-time communication and location-based features.
Implemented access control, session handling, and data validation for a secure user experience.
Deployed the platform using GitHub Actions (CI/CD) and version-controlled infrastructure with Git.
Designed and developed a crypto trade analytics dashboard using React and GraphQL, focused on tracking real-time Bitcoin trading activity.
Implemented live data fetching and filtering from external APIs to provide users with clear, actionable trade statistics.
Optimized UI rendering and data handling to display large datasets with minimal latency.
Built fully modular components with reusable logic and clear separation of concerns.
Built a custom tool to parse and analyze CSV log files from identity verification platforms, used internally to troubleshoot client-side SDK and API issues.
Leveraged React and Bootstrap to create a clean UI and seamless file upload experience.
Implemented client-side logic to detect, format, and highlight errors, allowing support engineers to resolve issues faster and with greater clarity.
Used by colleagues to streamline Tier 2 technical support and reduce debugging time by up to 30%.
Created a knowledge base system to organize technical solutions and internal documentation using React, Node.js, and JSON-based structured content.
Designed admin controls and search features to improve access to FAQs, workflow templates, and process guides.
Helped standardize onboarding and ticket resolution workflows for support engineers.
